brief: The 6-step pre-launch checklist that cuts post-ship hotfixes by 80%.

slots.subtitle: A disciplined pre-launch routine is the closest insurance founders have against midnight outages and angry churn.

slots.title: LOCK THE
slots.subtitle: Never ship with a warm branch. A frozen main protects the release from last-minute entropy and silent regression.
slots.bodyText: Every hotfix I have shipped traces back to a 'quick' Friday merge. Lock your main branch twelve hours before deploy and redirect new work to a staging line. This single habit eliminates half of self-inflicted regressions.
slots.calloutBody: A frozen branch is a promise to your future self.

slots.title: CLEAN YOUR
slots.subtitle: Outdated packages and dead code are not technical debt; they are liabilities waiting to become incidents at scale.
slots.bodyText: Run a full dependency audit and remove every unused import before you build. One unmaintained package has cost me more downtime than any algorithm bug. Treat your bundle like a carry-on bag: if it is not essential, leave it behind.
slots.calloutBody: Small bundles ship faster and break less.

slots.title: SMOKE TEST
slots.subtitle: Passing unit tests mean nothing if users cannot sign up, pay, and receive their welcome email in seconds.
slots.bodyText: Write end-to-end tests for the five flows that generate revenue or retention. Do not test every edge case; test the path your CEO will demo on launch day. If it breaks in production, you do not have a product—you have a landing page.
slots.calloutBody: Unit tests guard logic; smoke tests guard revenue.

slots.title: WATCH EVERY
slots.subtitle: Shipping without observability is like flying through fog without instruments: technically possible until the moment it is not.
slots.bodyText: Confirm your error boundaries catch exceptions and your alerts reach a human within seconds. Add logging to every external API call so you know whether the bug is yours or theirs. Visibility turns a three-hour war room into a five-minute config change.
slots.calloutBody: Logs are the flight recorder of your application.

slots.title: STRESS THE
slots.subtitle: Launch day traffic should be a celebration, not a crisis forcing you to scale your database at midnight.
slots.bodyText: Load-test your API with ten times expected traffic and measure mobile performance on a three-year-old device. If your time-to-first-byte exceeds one second under load, fix it now. Users forgive a missing feature; they do not forgive a frozen screen.
slots.calloutBody: Performance is a feature you cannot patch in retrospect.

slots.title: DEPLOY WITH
slots.subtitle: No release is safer than one you can disable in a click without redeploying code or explaining downtime.
slots.bodyText: Wrap every new feature in a toggle and ship to ten percent of traffic first. Prepare a one-command rollback that reverts to the last stable image in under sixty seconds. Confidence comes not from perfection, but from reversible decisions.
slots.calloutBody: Feature flags turn deploys from events into routines.

slots.ctaBody: Pre-launch discipline is the difference between a quiet weekend and a frantic hotfix sprint. Which step will you lock in first?
